facts.fact: Law no. 2010/021 of 21 December 2010 governing electronic commerce in Cameroon exists as a made law, and the Prime Minister's decree of 15 June 2011 fixes its application rules.
Decree no. 2011/1521/PM of 15 June 2011 fixes the modalities of application of law no. 2010/021 on electronic commerce, defining the scope of e-commerce activity.
